name: Middle Ages Ping Pong
description: Classic ping pong in a medieval setting: play against the computer or a friend on the same console.
author: STL1te
release_notes:
First release of Middle Ages Ping Pong: classic ping pong for one or two players in a medieval setting.

Game
- Play against the computer, or against a friend on the same console.
- The first to score 10 points wins the match.
- The spot where the ball meets the paddle sets the angle of the return, and every return makes the ball faster.
- 30 music tracks play during matches, and the game has its own music on the home screen of the console.

Controls
- Left stick or D-pad: move the paddle and move through menus.
- Cross: serve the ball and confirm in menus.
- Options: pause the match.
- Two players with one controller: the left stick moves the left paddle and the right stick moves the right one.
- Two players with two controllers: each player moves with the left stick of their own controller.

Requirements
- A jailbroken PS5 with system software 6.00 or later.

Install
Unzip PPSA28319.zip and copy the PPSA28319 folder to /data/homebrew/.
